title: Effect switches are real buttons on the pages the family sweeps missed
notes: Follow-up from image-family-pages-use-the-real-adjustment-glyph. The DS now says .efx .en is a <button> with aria-pressed (core.js owns the press; canvas.css owns the reset; AGENTS.md 'Effect row enable'). A post-fix browser sweep over all 89 pages found inert span.en left on: editor, language, lang-panels, lang-sections, video, video-audio, video-captions, video-compositing, video-speed. Same sweep also found the deprecated .cmdk still authored on lang-toolbars and language. app-shell, states, typography and draw-boolean are already covered by their own family tasks, so leave those alone. Verify with the browser sweep, not a grep: 200 on every page, audit-sweep.js clean, and zero '.efx span.en' / '.cmdk' on the pages listed here.
